title: We are a team of academic scientists, AI researchers, and more. Meet the Team
content: Meet the team FutureHouse brings together experts across disciplines to scale scientific research and accelerate the pace of discovery. Sam Rodriques CEO, Co-founder Andrew White Head of Science, Co-founder Jessica Wu Head of Operations Geemi Wellawatte AI Technical Lead If this mission and these ideas are exciting to you, get in touch. Open Roles FutureHouse Fellows The FutureHouse Fellowship program supports recent PhD graduates who chart their own scientific paths at the intersection of AI and science. View All Fellows 2025 Cohort Sarah Gurev Co-Advisor: Sergey Ovchinnikov , Aaron Schmidt Sarah is a machine learning researcher specializing in protein design and virology. Infectious Disease Full Bio Philine Guckelberger Co-Advisor: Jesse Engreitz Philine is a molecular biologist fascinated by 3D genome architecture and epigenomic regulation. Genomics Cancer Full Bio Laura Luebbert Co-Advisor: Pardis Sabeti Laura is a computational biologist specializing in machine learning methods for infectious disease discovery and triage. Infectious Disease Full Bio Dániel Barabási Co-Advisor: None Dániel was awarded a PhD in Biophysics from Harvard in 2023. His work blends neuroscience, network science, and machine learning. Neuroscience Full Bio Chenghao Liu Co-Advisor: Frances Arnold Chenghao is a chemist and machine-learning scientist working at the interface of molecular design and emergent physical properties. Synthetic Biology Full Bio Blake Lash Co-Advisor: Fei Chen Blake is a molecular biologist dedicated to accelerating the discovery of next-generation therapies. Immunology Full Bio FutureHouse Fellows The FutureHouse Fellowship program supports recent PhD graduates who chart their own scientific paths at the intersection of AI and science. View All Fellows Andrew Lu Co-Advisor: Michael Elowitz Andrew is closing the loop between AI-driven design and experimental validation to accelerate the discovery of programmable therapeutics. These therapies will expand how cells sense, compute, and act inside the human body. Synthetic Biology Full Bio Soojung Yang Co-Advisor: Grant Rotskoff Soojung will build machine learning models that unify protein structure, thermodynamics, and kinetics, and deploy agentic AI to search variant space and enable biochemistry-informed protein optimization. Biophysics Full Bio Jeremy Koob Co-Advisor: David Baker Jeremy will develop and integrate AI agents into protein design workflows to accelerate the discovery of biocatalysts for sustainable chemistry. Synthetic Biology Full Bio Alexander Starr Co-Advisor: Alex Pollen Kavli-Supported Fellow Alex will use AI scientists to massively expand the scope and scale of these evolutionary genomics analyses, with the goal of uncovering the genetic basis of behavioral adaptations and neurological disease across the mammalian tree of life. Neuroscience Genomics Full Bio Hanqing Liu Co-Advisor: Michael Greenberg Hanqing will build AI-driven frameworks that integrate large-scale single-cell and functional genomics datasets to reconstruct the regulatory architecture of psychiatric disorders and generate mechanistic hypotheses at scale.
